callouts.label: Open Cough Route
callouts.hint: A child coughs into open air at the lower left.
callouts.description: Droplets from an uncovered cough can carry germs through the air and onto nearby surfaces.
callouts.ap_tip: Turn away and cover with an elbow or tissue.

callouts.label: Hand-to-Face Route
callouts.hint: A child touches their nose and mouth.
callouts.description: Hands can move germs from a surface to the eyes, nose, or mouth.
callouts.ap_tip: Clean hands and fewer face touches interrupt this route.

callouts.label: Shared Toy Route
callouts.hint: Several children pass and build with the same blocks.
callouts.description: Shared items can pick up germs from one hand and carry them to another.
callouts.ap_tip: Handwashing before food and after nose care helps.

callouts.label: Busy Doorknob Route
callouts.hint: Several children touch the same door hardware.
callouts.description: Many hands touch doorknobs, so germs can collect even when the knob looks clean.
callouts.ap_tip: Wash hands regularly instead of trying to see germs.

callouts.label: Desk and Crayon Route
callouts.hint: Children share crayons across a table.
callouts.description: Hands, desks, and shared supplies can form a chain that moves germs.
callouts.ap_tip: Cleaning and handwashing create breaks in the chain.

callouts.label: Snack Route
callouts.hint: A child handles a snack near a lunchbox.
callouts.description: Germs on hands can reach food and then the mouth.

callouts.label: Tissue Roadblock
callouts.hint: A used tissue goes directly into a lined trash bin.
callouts.description: A tissue catches droplets; throwing it away keeps those droplets off hands and tables.
callouts.ap_tip: Wash hands after blowing your nose.

callouts.label: Elbow Roadblock
callouts.hint: A child coughs into the inside of an elbow.
callouts.description: An elbow cover blocks many droplets and keeps them off the hands.
callouts.ap_tip: Use your elbow when a tissue is not ready.

callouts.label: Soap-and-Water Roadblock
callouts.hint: Hands scrub under running water with soap.
callouts.description: Soap and running water remove germs from all parts of the hands.
callouts.ap_tip: Scrub palms, backs, between fingers, and around nails.

callouts.label: Clean-Surface Roadblock
callouts.hint: An adult cleans a commonly touched table.
callouts.description: Cleaning shared surfaces is a community health practice that reduces germ routes.
callouts.ap_tip: Healthy classrooms use several roadblocks together.
